content: Cefuroxime axetil is available in the form of CEFTIN tablets. CEFTIN tablets containing 250 mg of cefuroxime (as cefuroxime axetil) are white, capsule-shaped, film-coated tablets. These tablets are engraved with GX ES7 on one side and are blank on the other. They are supplied in bottles containing 20 tablets, with the National Drug Code (NDC) 0173-0387-00. CEFTIN tablets containing 500 mg of cefuroxime (as cefuroxime axetil) are also white, capsule-shaped, film-coated tablets. These tablets are engraved with GX EG2 on one side and are blank on the other. They are supplied in bottles containing 20 tablets, with the NDC 0173-0394-00. The tablets should be stored at a temperature between 15°C and 30°C (59°F and 86°F). After each use, the cap should be securely replaced to maintain the integrity of the product. CEFTIN is also available as an oral suspension. The CEFTIN oral suspension is provided as a dry, white to off-white powder with a tutti-frutti flavor. When reconstituted according to the instructions, the suspension delivers the equivalent of either 125 mg or 250 mg of cefuroxime (as cefuroxime axetil) per 5 mL of suspension. The oral suspension is supplied in amber glass bottles as follows: 125 mg/5 mL: 100-mL suspension, NDC 0173-0740-00 250 mg/5 mL: 50-mL suspension, NDC 0173-0741-10 250 mg/5 mL: 100-mL suspension, NDC 0173-0741-00 Before reconstitution, the dry powder should be stored at a temperature between 2°C and 30°C (36°F and 86°F). After reconstitution, the suspension should be immediately stored in a refrigerator at a temperature between 2°C and 8°C (36°F and 46°F). The reconstituted suspension must be discarded after 10 days.
